function.name: artifact_create
function.description: Create a reusable creative miniapp in the user’s library. Default to working interactive HTML: to-do trackers, calculators, interactive infographics, dashboards, process synoptics with KPIs, simulators or other bespoke apps. Choose a layout for the task; implement real controls, keyboard access, responsive views and useful empty states. Use custom for any app, task-tracker for tasks, chart for charts; document is only for explicitly requested static Markdown documents. Render from window.DOME_DATA, persist edits with window.__dome_updateState(nextData), and redraw through window.dome_onDataRefresh(next). Use Dome CSS variables. Return a resource link after success. No separate design tool and no inline artifact blocks.

title.description: Name of the miniapp in the library. If omitted, derived from its first heading.

artifact_type.description: custom accepts any creative miniapp, including calculators, dashboards, infographics and process diagrams. document only for explicit static-document requests.

content.description: Markdown only when the user explicitly requests a static document; omit for miniapps.

html.description: Complete functional body HTML with inline JavaScript. Include the actual interactions, calculations and visualizations; no placeholder buttons or prose-only substitutes.

css.description: Optional stylesheet, using Dome theme variables and responsive layouts.

function.name: artifact_get
function.description: Get full artifact state (html, data, metadata) by resource ID.

function.name: artifact_merge_data
function.description: Shallow-merge keys into persisted artifact state.data without resending HTML. Use after excel_get / resource_get to push rows, counters, or blobs. Top-level keys replace or add; nested subtrees replace by key. Prefer over pasting huge datasets into HTML.

function.name: artifact_update_state
function.description: Customize an existing miniapp in place, preserving its resource link and all omitted fields. Read artifact_get first. html replaces the interactive interface; css replaces its stylesheet; data replaces the whole data object. artifact_type=custom with html explicitly converts a static document to a miniapp while retaining data. content is only for static documents. Pass expected_version to detect conflicts.

expected_version.description: Version read before editing; conflicts require a fresh read

html.description: New body HTML if replacing UI

data.description: Replacement data object; omitted keys are removed

artifact_type.description: Optional explicit format change. To convert a document into a miniapp, pass custom and complete html.

css.description: Replacement stylesheet; omit to preserve existing CSS.

function.name: artifact_list
function.description: List persisted artifacts in a project (titles, ids, types).

function.name: artifact_delete
function.description: Delete a persisted artifact resource and remove it from the library.

function.name: artifact_link_resource
function.description: Link (or unlink) a persisted artifact to an Excel/spreadsheet resource. Once linked: Dome auto-refreshes the artifact whenever the spreadsheet is edited and exposes all sheet data as window.DOME_DATA.linkedData.sheets[sheetName]. A "Refresh data" button appears in the artifact toolbar. Use this when the user asks to link a dashboard to an Excel, or when an artifact was created without linkedResourceId. Pass linked_resource_id=null to remove the link.

artifact_resource_id.description: Resource ID of the artifact to link

linked_resource_id.description: Resource ID of the Excel/spreadsheet to link to, or null to unlink
